entries.what: No school for Indigenous Peoples' Day. Dulce sleeps in, then does homework at the kitchen table in Marisol Gardens unit 114 while her mom Yesenia works.
entries.outcome: Finished geometry and half of her English reading.

entries.what: Walks to Delgado Park in the afternoon and watches a pickup soccer game. She texts Karina about the weekend.
entries.outcome: Karina agrees to meet before the game later this week.

entries.what: Spends the evening making an edit video she never posts, with corridos tumbados playing.
entries.outcome: Saves the video to drafts again.

entries.what: Walks to Flats High and goes through classes. In third period chemistry with Ms. Tolentino she does the mole calculations fast with Karina.
entries.outcome: Lab partner work done on time.

entries.what: Eats lunch in room B12 with Karina and Eli.
entries.outcome: Calm lunch, no drama.

entries.what: After school, does homework and gets home before the 9:30 curfew. Yesenia checks that her chem is done.
entries.outcome: Homework finished by 9.

entries.what: School day. At lunch Dulce, Karina and Eli agree she will go to the Friday homecoming game with them and skip the dance.
entries.outcome: Plan set for the game on Friday.

entries.what: Stops by Cloud Nine Tea Bar after school but only orders one drink. Kyla is at the register.
entries.outcome: Keeps to the one drink.

entries.what: Does chem worksheets at home and texts the group chat 'lab rats' until bedtime.
entries.outcome: Worksheets done, a little late to bed.

entries.what: Goes to school. Third period is a chem review day and Ms. Tolentino returns quizzes.
entries.outcome: Quiz score is okay but not great.

entries.what: Thursday evening she goes to the family pupusa stand and folds to-go boxes for Tía Gladys.
entries.outcome: Boxes were folded fast enough, with no redos.

entries.what: Rafael drives her home from the stand. They talk about his midterm studying.
entries.outcome: Home before curfew.

entries.what: School day, then Dulce takes the 22 bus down Calle Ortega for her Friday 4-9 shift at Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Clocked in on time.

entries.what: Works the counter through the after-shift rush. She eats her free quesadilla and counts the drawer at close.
entries.outcome: Drawer matched to the penny.

entries.what: Rafael picks her up at 9 and drives her home.
entries.outcome: Home by 9:30.

entries.what: Efraín asks Dulce to pick up an extra Saturday 11-3 shift during the fall rush. She says yes right away, even though she was due to help at the stand that weekend.
entries.outcome: Extra Saturday shift added to her schedule.

entries.what: Works 11-3 at Taquería Colima, busy with the lunch rush, with Camila and Héctor.
entries.outcome: Shift went by fast and tips were good.

entries.what: Afterward she works out how to tell Tía Gladys she can't help at the stand this weekend and drafts a message to her.
entries.outcome: Sends a careful message; Gladys is understanding.

entries.what: Does the Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room in the evening.
entries.outcome: Laundry done.

entries.what: Works her Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima. Efraín is pleased with the rush numbers.
entries.outcome: Long shift finished.

entries.what: Gets home in the evening and eats dinner with Yesenia. They talk about her phone savings and the $20 per check phone bill.
entries.outcome: Still saving for the phone.

entries.what: Sunday night she texts Karina and does leftover chem work before bed.
entries.outcome: Chem finished.
